title: The starvation observation compares realized lanes with the wave's sized width, not 'any quota shrink excuses the wave'
summary: WaveObservation.Starved returns false whenever the bench shrank the wave, so waves 19 and 20 (1 and 0 of 2 sized lanes after codex's bench took 3 to 2) counted as not starved. A quota shrink explains only the lanes it removed. Supersedes go/acs/cycle544's rule. Design doc §7.7 W4.
acceptance: Starved compares realized lanes with the sized width; go/acs/cycle544 is superseded with a documented reason.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: a quota shrink switches off the starvation detector, which hid waves 19 and 20
